description: The companion describes its own persona/personality. The archiver must NOT form memories about the companion's own personality, card, or persona. Only genuine user facts should surface.

conversation.content: I'm warm, a little playful, and I love astronomy — I always bring up constellations.
Ha, you really do. By the way, I actually studied astrophysics in undergrad, so keep the star talk coming.
Perfect, a real astrophysicist to keep me honest.
I dropped it for software after graduation though.
